changelog: With registries disabled, `apm install` names the `$APM_HOME` file that configures registries instead of blaming apm.yml, and prints `Run 'apm experimental enable registries'` (#4217)

ledger_row.summary: With a registry configured in $APM_HOME/config.json and the registries feature disabled, install --frozen reported 'Failed to parse apm.yml' and printed its fix as 'Enable with: ...' instead of naming the user configuration and a runnable 'apm ...' command.

red: APM_BINARY_PATH="$(uv run which apm)" uv run --extra dev pytest tests/integration/test_frozen_replay_output_lifecycle.py -k registries_disabled -n 0 -p no:cacheprovider -q -> assert "[x] Registry configuration in <APM_HOME>/config.json requires the experimental registries feature. Run 'apm experimental enable registries' to enable it." in "... [x] Failed to parse apm.yml: Registry configuration requires the experimental registries feature. Enable with: apm experimental enable registries. ..."
green: same command -> 1 passed (the printed 'apm experimental enable registries' is executed and the frozen re-run exits 0 with unchanged state)
owner: src/apm_cli/deps/registry/feature_gate.py (require_package_registry_enabled: message form, config_source, UserRegistryConfigDisabledError); src/apm_cli/deps/registry/config_loader.py (user_registry_config_path); caller src/apm_cli/models/apm_package.py; renderer src/apm_cli/commands/install.py (_install_apm_packages renders the user-config error without the apm.yml prefix)
notes: The 'Run ...' remediation form applies to every caller of require_package_registry_enabled. Out of scope, observed: 'apm audit --ci' on the same state still reports 'Cannot parse apm.yml: ... -- fix the YAML syntax error in apm.yml' (manifest-parse check wraps every parse error); other commands (update, lock, deps, prune) still prefix 'Failed to parse apm.yml:'. commands/install.py is also touched by #4138 (one import + one except clause).
